import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'

def write_project(name, source, manifest_extra=''):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
        [package]
        name="{name}"
        version="0.1.0"

        [[target.bin]]
        name="{name}"
        path="src/main.fzy"
        {manifest_extra}
    '''))
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
    return root

root = write_project('language_policy_default', '''
    fn main() -> i32 {
        return 0
    }
''')
proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
policy = json.loads((root / '.fz' / 'language-policy.json').read_text())
assert policy['schemaVersion'] == 'fozzylang.language_policy.v1', policy
assert policy['language']['defaultTier'] == 'core_v1', policy
assert policy['language']['changePolicy'] == 'additive_only', policy
syntax = {item['name'] for item in policy['syntaxFreeze']['surface']}
for required in ['fn','let','let mut','struct','enum','match','trait','impl','async','await','rpc','unsafe metadata','defer','use core.*','extern','pubext']:
    assert required in syntax, (required, syntax)
assert policy['profiles']['dev']['backend'] == 'cranelift', policy['profiles']['dev']
assert policy['profiles']['dev']['unsafeContractsEnforced'] is False, policy['profiles']['dev']
assert policy['profiles']['strict']['backend'] == 'llvm', policy['profiles']['strict']
assert policy['profiles']['strict']['optimizationLevel'] == 'O2+g', policy['profiles']['strict']
assert policy['profiles']['strict']['diagnosticStrictness'] == 'strict', policy['profiles']['strict']
assert policy['profiles']['strict']['emitSafetyArtifacts'] is True, policy['profiles']['strict']
policy_md = (root / '.fz' / 'language-policy.md').read_text()
assert '## Syntax Freeze' in policy_md, policy_md
assert '| `strict` | `true` | `true` | `llvm` |' in policy_md, policy_md

override_root = write_project('language_policy_override', '''
    fn risky() -> i32 { return 1 }
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let v = try risky() catch 0
        return v
    }
''', '''
[language]
tier="experimental"
allow_experimental=true

[profiles.strict]
backend="cranelift"
checks=false
optimize=false
diagnostic_strictness="standard"
emit_safety_artifacts=false
''')
override_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(override_root), '--strict', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
override_payload = json.loads(override_proc.stdout.strip())
assert override_proc.returncode == 0, (override_proc.returncode, override_payload, override_proc.stderr)
override_policy = json.loads((override_root / '.fz' / 'language-policy.json').read_text())
assert override_policy['language']['defaultTier'] == 'experimental', override_policy
assert override_policy['language']['allowExperimental'] is True, override_policy
strict = override_policy['profiles']['strict']
assert strict['backend'] == 'cranelift', strict
assert strict['checksEnabled'] is False, strict
assert strict['optimize'] is False, strict
assert strict['diagnosticStrictness'] == 'standard', strict
assert strict['emitSafetyArtifacts'] is False, strict
assert strict['experimentalFeaturesAllowed'] is True, strict
print('compiler-language-profile-freeze-ok')
